ui_adm_owner_hint: Search every character in the database by name or citizen ID. Online players are listed first.
ui_adm_reset_desc: Wipes all livestock, troughs, coops, storages (and their contents), supply orders and ownership, and fires every member of staff. No refund is paid.
ui_adm_add_storage_desc: Adds an extra storage to this ranch free of charge.
ui_adm_settings_desc: Overrides for this ranch. Saved to the database, applied instantly for every player and kept across restarts. Leave a field blank to use the config value.
ui_adm_confirm_owner: Make %s the owner of %s? The current owner (if any) will be removed from the ranch job.
ui_adm_confirm_remove_owner: Remove %s as owner? Livestock and storages are kept and the ranch goes back up for sale.
ui_adm_confirm_reset: Reset %s to default? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_fire_all: Fire every member of staff at %s (the owner is kept)?
ui_adm_confirm_delete_all: Delete all %s animals at %s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_animal: Delete animal #%s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_empty: Empty every item out of %s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_storage: Delete %s and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_reset_settings: Reset %s back to its config values?
